verdict.rationale: Vanta documents questionnaire automation: it generates answers from a knowledge base and prior questionnaires, automates questionnaires "from start to finish" with review/approve/submit, and offers API endpoints for questionnaire responses. None of the evidence covers the story's core, which is handling SIG, CAIQ, portal or spreadsheet formats on import and exporting back in the customer's original format. missing for 10: named format support (SIG, CAIQ, spreadsheets), portal-based questionnaire handling, round-trip export in the sender's format, independent or hands-on corroboration.
